subject: Can't load data to worker nodes, running SparkR on EC2

messages.author: b4e76ba6d40254bf
messages.subject: Can't load data to worker nodes, running SparkR on EC2
parts:
Let me start with the error message, then I'll post the console output from a previous step that I think highlights the problem.  

This is running RStudio locally on my laptop, connecting to an EC2 cluster that spun up using the EC2 script that comes with the 1.4 release of Spark.

Working from the dataframes.R example shipped with 1.4 for SparkR, it fails on the step.  Better yet, it hangs on the step and continues with the same error message indefinitely.

right Spark config values. BTW are you using SparkR that is now a part
of the Spark 1.4 release ? If so please post your question to the
Spark user mailing list as there are other users you might have seen
similar issues etc.

Shivaram

messages.author: b4e76ba6d40254bf
messages.subject: Re: Can't load data to worker nodes, running SparkR on EC2
parts:
Shivaram, thanks for pointing me in the right direction on where to post questions like this. For others following this thread, I think this is the next thread to read on the Spark user mailing list and take the conversation there if you have follow up questions.
http://apache-spark-user-list.1001560.n3.nabble.com/Spark-1-4-0-Using-SparkR-on-EC2-Instance-td23506.html

I believe the problem was that the scripts were not designed to allow someone to use a local IDE to connect to the cluster.  Instead I installed the RStudio IDE on the driver and these issues went away.

Ben
